query:
UPDATE media_attachments j
        SET state       = 'merged',
            merged_into = held.id,
            lease_until = NULL
        FROM (
            SELECT id FROM media_attachments
            WHERE author_id = $2 AND digest = $3 AND state = 'ready'
              AND held_at IS NULL
        ) held
        WHERE j.id = $1 AND j.state = 'processing'
        RETURNING held.id
